title: Ye Kaisi Sakht Mushkil Ki Ghadi Hai
body:
Ye kaisi saqt mushkil ki ghadi hai,
Khule sar raahoun me binte Ali(as) hai.
1)Jahan se chal basey Aun o Mohammad(as),
Ye Zainab(sa) par qiyamat ki ghadi hai.
2) Bana Qasim(as) hua paamaal run me,
Bani ek pal me bewa hogayi hai.
3) Kataakar sota hai shaanou ko Ghazi,
Wafa dariya pe maatam kar rahi hai.
4) Kaha laashe pe Akbar(as) ke ye maa ne,
Meri saari kamaayi lut gayi hai.
5) Ali Asghar(as) ke khoo'n ka hai tasadduq,
Khuda ke deen ki jo zindagi hai.
6)Na kar bacche ko mere qatl zaalim,
Sadaa Zehra(sa) ki run me goonjti hai.
7)Qayamat ka hai manzar Karbala me,
Sinaa par ab sar e Sibt-e-Nabi(sa) hai.
8) Laeeno ne jalaaye saare qaime,
Nabi(sa) ki aal beparda khadi hai.
9) Sitam us par Kiya Shimr-e-laee'n ke,
Jo Bacchi Sheh ke naazoun ki pali hai.
10) Ye Nouha turbat-e-Shabbir(as) par ho,
Tamanna Sahil o Hasnain ki hai.
